# Roadmap

<!-- Generated by `bun run roadmap` from features/. Edit those files, not this one. -->

Phases are rough order, not releases. Each feature's file in [features/](features) has its details.

## Phase 1: The floating window

Hovering a link shows its page in a small window that floats over every app, and moves like picture in picture. Shipped in 1.1.0.

> [!area] Window
>
> - [x] [Floating window](features/Phase%201/Floating%20window.md): Link previews open in a small window that floats over every app, on every Space, instead of a popover.
> - [x] [Liquid Glass](features/Phase%201/Liquid%20Glass.md): The desktop shows through the window, blurred, behind a slightly darker page panel (macOS 26 or later).
> - [x] [Edge bars](features/Phase%201/Edge%20bars.md): At rest the page sits in a thin border; when the cursor comes near an edge, that edge grows into a slim bar.
>   - [x] [Top bar](features/Phase%201/Top%20bar.md): The page's buttons and a close button; drag or two-finger swipe here to move the window.
>   - [x] [Bottom bar](features/Phase%201/Bottom%20bar.md): ‹ the note's name and position ›, stepping to the previous or next note in order.
>   - [x] [Scroll rail](features/Phase%201/Scroll%20rail.md): A scroll rail on the right edge with a mark for each section: properties, callouts and headings.

> [!area] Moving it
>
> - [x] [Snap to spots](features/Phase%201/Snap%20to%20spots.md): Throw the window and it springs to the nearest of eight spots: the corners and the middle of each side.
> - [x] [Tuck to the side](features/Phase%201/Tuck%20to%20the%20side.md): Throw the window past the left or right edge to tuck it behind a thin handle; click, drag or swipe the handle to bring it back.
> - [x] [Screen limits](features/Phase%201/Screen%20limits.md): The window stops at the menu bar, rubber-bands past the bottom of the screen, and remembers where you left it.

> [!area] Pages
>
> - [x] [Hover to change pages](features/Phase%201/Hover%20to%20change%20pages.md): The page changes the moment you hover another link.
> - [x] [Page transitions](features/Phase%201/Page%20transitions.md): Pages slide up or down depending on where the link is, and sideways when stepping through the order.
> - [x] [Properties pill](features/Phase%201/Properties%20pill.md): Properties start as a small "› Properties" pill and morph open when clicked.
> - [x] [Overscroll](features/Phase%201/Overscroll.md): Scrolling past the top or bottom of a page rubber-bands, and flicks bounce off the ends.

> [!area] Obsidian
>
> - [x] [Order notes](features/Phase%201/Order%20notes.md): The bottom bar steps through notes in the order of the link lists in your order notes.
> - [x] [Mark the previewed note](features/Phase%201/Mark%20the%20previewed%20note.md): Links to the previewed note turn yellow in Obsidian's other windows and in the file list.
> - [x] [Toggle preview window](features/Phase%201/Toggle%20preview%20window.md): "Toggle preview window" in the command palette switches back to Obsidian's own popovers.
> - [x] [Settings](features/Phase%201/Settings.md): Settings for glass, darkness, Spaces, swipes, overscroll, marking and order notes.

> [!area] Shipping
>
> - [x] [Install with BRAT](features/Phase%201/Install%20with%20BRAT.md): BRAT installs the plugin from GitHub releases and keeps it updated.
> - [x] [Install from source](features/Phase%201/Install%20from%20source.md): `scripts/install.sh` builds the native parts for this Mac and links a vault's plugin folder back to the repo.
> - [x] [Release workflow](features/Phase%201/Release%20workflow.md): Pushing a version tag builds universal native parts, writes their checksums into `main.js` and publishes the release.

## Phase 2: Feel

Making the window feel native: borderless chrome, haptics, and a tuck that holds up everywhere. Planned as 1.2.0. Prototypes of most of these are on the `backup-dev` and `backup-local-main` branches; bring them over one at a time. Lines marked *Proposed* come from the Notion list and don't have files yet.

> [!area] Chrome
>
> - [ ] [Borderless top bar](features/Phase%202/Borderless%20top%20bar.md): No traffic lights: the menu sits in the top bar's left corner and the close button in the right.
> - [ ] [Menus at the button](features/Phase%202/Menus%20at%20the%20button.md): Menus opened from the preview (More options, a right-click) open at the button, over the preview window.
> - [x] [Settings cards](features/Phase%202/Settings%20cards.md): Each settings group (Look, Behaviour, Order) sits in one card, like Obsidian's own settings.
> - *Proposed:* Links clicked in the preview open in Obsidian instead of replacing the preview's page.

> [!area] Tucking
>
> - [ ] [Tuck haptics](features/Phase%202/Tuck%20haptics.md): A tap on the trackpad as a tucking window lands at the side.
> - [ ] [Magnet tuck](features/Phase%202/Magnet%20tuck.md): Pushed a quarter of the way past a side while held, a magnet pulls the window into its tucked place.
> - [ ] [Handle slides along its side](features/Phase%202/Handle%20slides%20along%20its%20side.md): Drag or swipe a tucked handle up and down its side; pull it 40px away to bring the window out.
> - [ ] [Tucked window stays put across Spaces](features/Phase%202/Tucked%20window%20stays%20put%20across%20Spaces.md): A tucked window rests as just its handle, fully on screen, so switching Spaces no longer pulls it partway back.

> [!area] Moving it
>
> - [ ] [Pinch to resize](features/Phase%202/Pinch%20to%20resize.md): Pinch on the window to resize it like macOS picture in picture, keeping its shape and docked corner.
> - [ ] [Swipes stop at the screen edge](features/Phase%202/Swipes%20stop%20at%20the%20screen%20edge.md): Swiping the window to a screen's edge stops it there instead of losing it.
> - *Proposed:* The window stays in the same place while it opens and closes.

> [!area] Obsidian
>
> - [ ] [One preview per vault](features/Phase%202/One%20preview%20per%20vault.md): Each vault keeps its own preview, so another vault running another version doesn't take over this one.

## Phase 3: Everywhere

Working in any vault and theme, and a look of its own. Planned as 1.3.0. Lines marked *Proposed* come from the Notion list and don't have files yet.

> [!area] Any vault
>
> - *Proposed:* Support more themes and their options, beyond Cupertino.
> - *Proposed:* Find which other plugins' and themes' behaviors affect the preview, starting from an empty vault.
> - *Proposed:* Tests that run without taking over the screen.

> [!area] Identity
>
> - *Proposed:* Snapped to the top middle, the window morphs into the MacBook's notch.
> - *Proposed:* Settings panel changes.
> - *Proposed:* Updated page navigation styling.

> [!area] Triage
>
> - *Proposed:* Screen magnet targets, with UI showing where the window will land.
> - *Proposed:* "Copper by shadcn" parody.
